"Create a playable mobile MOBA game – ARAM 3v3

Create a fully playable 2D top-down multiplayer-style MOBA prototype inspired by the ARAM game mode of League of Legends.

IMPORTANT: Prioritize actual gameplay functionality over graphics, menus or cinematic effects.

GAME MODE

- 3 versus 3 arena combat.
- One single lane map.
- Two opposing teams: Blue and Red.
- Each team has three champions.
- One tower and one nexus per team.
- The objective is to destroy the enemy nexus.
- Match duration: approximately 8–12 minutes.

CHAMPION SELECTION

Create a champion selection screen with 15 selectable original champions.

Include these roles:

- 3 Tanks
- 3 Fighters
- 3 Mages
- 2 Marksmen
- 2 Assassins
- 2 Supports

Each champion must have:

- Unique character appearance.
- Health and mana.
- Attack damage.
- Movement speed.
- Four different abilities.
- Basic attack.
- Individual cooldowns.
- Unique combat animations.

GAMEPLAY CONTROLS

Design mobile-friendly touchscreen controls.

- Virtual joystick on the bottom left.
- Basic attack button on the bottom right.
- Four ability buttons.
- Health and mana bars.
- Cooldown indicators.
- Champion level and experience.
- Minimap or compact battlefield indicator.

BATTLEFIELD

Create a fantasy-themed single-lane arena.

- Blue team starts on the left.
- Red team starts on the right.
- Three champions per team.
- Defensive towers.
- Minions that automatically advance toward the enemy.
- Health regeneration zones near each base.
- Clear collision detection.
- Camera follows the controlled champion.

ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE

Create three enemy AI champions with different roles.

- Tank AI protects teammates.
- Marksman AI attacks from a distance.
- Assassin AI tries to eliminate vulnerable enemies.

All AI must be able to move, attack, use abilities and retreat when health is low.

Create two allied AI teammates that help the player.

COMBAT SYSTEM

- Real-time combat.
- Damage calculations.
- Critical hits.
- Crowd control effects.
- Healing and shields.
- Ability cooldowns.
- Death and respawn system.
- Champion progression during the match.

GAME OBJECTIVE

Destroy enemy towers and finally destroy the enemy nexus.

Display victory or defeat screens when the match ends.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

- Must be playable on Android mobile screens.
- Optimized for touchscreen controls.
- Smooth character movement.
- Functional abilities and attacks.
- Working AI opponents.
- No buttons without functionality.
- No placeholder gameplay.
- Use simple 2D sprites and effects if necessary.

DEVELOPMENT PRIORITY

Build the game in functional stages:

1. Create the arena and movement system.
2. Implement basic attacks and health.
3. Implement three champions per team.
4. Implement enemy and allied AI.
5. Add champion abilities.
6. Add towers, minions and nexus.
7. Add champion selection and menus.
8. Polish graphics and sound effects.

First deliver a complete playable prototype with one working match. Do not attempt to build all 15 champions before the core gameplay works.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
